about.title: About
about.tagline: Three in a row. One more game.
about.storyHeading: A small game with a long story
about.storyParagraphOne: This game began in 2017 as a learning project by Shahrukh Shamim, exploring how a computer could plan its next move.
about.storyParagraphTwo: Years later, it’s back with a fresh look and a new home on your phone. The curiosity that started it is still here.
about.customizeDescription: Play offline against the computer. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard, pick your symbol and color, and decide who starts in Settings.
about.footer: Made with curiosity. Built to play.
